Messages.Author: Aaron
Messages.Body:
I was thinking, what happens when I am playing at a 5 man table, and I
just sweep through my first 3 VP. Can I make a deal to just give up
the other 2VP if I don't want them? I mean, I have already won. If
I'm tired of playing an I just give up and transfer out or concead or
whatever?

Aaron.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Aaron wrote:
>
> I was thinking, what happens when I am playing at a 5 man table, and I
> just sweep through my first 3 VP. Can I make a deal to just give up
> the other 2VP if I don't want them?

Yes. How you win is up to you (so long was the deal was made only on
in-game considerations).

Well tireness doesn't seem like an in-game consideration to me. As he
described it, it seems like he got the first 3 VP all alone without the help

You snipped the important last part of his post "I mean, I have already won.

If
I'm tired of playing an I just give up and transfer out or concead or

whatever?" which was giving the reasons to the conceding.
